<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 55:1">Gen. R. s. 55</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 60:6">Ps. LX, 6</cite>) <he>כנס הזה וכ׳</he> like the flag of a ship; <cite ref="Psalms 60:6">ib.</cite> (ref. to <he>נסה</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 22:1">Gen. XXII, 1</cite>) <he>גדלו כנס וכ׳</he> he lifted Abraham up like &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 777:6">Yalk. Ps. 777</cite> <he>כנסו של וכ׳</he> (read: <he>כנס זה</he>); a. e.
<cite ref="Niddah 31a:58">Nidd. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>אפי׳ בעל הנס אינו מכיר בנִסּוֹ</he> even he to whom the providential sign happens, does not recognize it.
<cite ref="Yoma 21a:4">Yoma 21ᵃ</cite> <he>כרובים בנס וכ׳</he> the cherubs (above the ark in the Solomonic Temple) stood by a miracle.
<cite ref="Yoma 21a:4">Ib.</cite>, a. e. <he>נס גדול היה וכ׳</he> a great miracle was connected with the show-bread which was as fresh at its removal &c.
<cite ref="Sotah 47a:1">Sot. 47ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>נס בתוך נס</he> a double wonder.
<cite ref="Nedarim 41a:6">Ned. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>גדול נס שנעשה וכ׳</he> the wonder of recovery which the sick man experiences, is greater than that which happened to Hananiah, Mishael &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 23a:6">Sabb. 23ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אף הן היו באותו הנס</he> the women, too, were concerned in that wonderful delivery.

<cite ref="Shabbat 23a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ונימעוט נס</he> why not omit the benediction mentioning the wonder (<he>שעשה נסים וכ׳</he>)?; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>נִסִּים</he>, <he>נִסִּין</he>, <cite ref="M01772"><he>נִי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 9:1">Ber. IX, 1</cite> <he>הרואה מקום שנעשו בו נ׳ … ברוך שעשה נ׳ וכ׳</he> he who sees a place where miracles happened to Israel, must say, Blessed be he who performed wonders &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 60a:12">Ib. 60ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מעשה נ׳</he> (abbrev. <he>מ״נ</he>) a miraculous event, v. <cite ref="G00467"><he>זָכַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 29a:4">Yoma 29ᵃ</cite> <he>אסתר סוף כל הנ׳</he> the Book of Esther is the last record of miracles.
<cite ref="Taanit 25a:4">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 109a">Snh. 109ᵃ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="L00565"><he>לָמַד</he></cite>; a. v. fr.
